key_insight: The study identified thinking-oriented objectives and technical content needed for a fabrication and welding learning module in North-Central Nigerian technical colleges.
engineering_relevance: The proposed curriculum requirements connect practical welding and fabrication competencies with critical thinking, problem-solving, safety, and quality control.
method: Research and Development design to identify module objectives and content.
Expert-validated questionnaire administered to 31 teachers and 21 industrial personnel.
Mean ratings, standard deviations, and independent-samples t-tests at the 0.05 significance level.
evidence_signal: Ratings from 52 respondents supported the identified requirements, with no statistically significant differences between teacher and industrial-personnel ratings.
watch_item: The abstract reports stakeholder requirements, not classroom trials demonstrating improved learning or welding performance.
paper_title: Objectives And Content Required for Developing a Thinking-Based Learning Module in Fabrication and Welding in Technical Colleges in North-Central Nigeria
